name: Slime Wall
description: Hold down to transform into a towering slime wall that reflects enemy projectiles with a sticky trail.

name: Fling Burst
description: Masterful momentum lets you fling bouncing slime globs that leave trails wherever they travel.

name: Amethyst Core
description: Unlock the purple health passive that boosts damage output as your HP rises.

name: Renewal Bloom
description: Spend vital essence to regenerate back to 10 HP when you dip below it.

name: Corrosive Secrets
description: Enable platform melting, letting slime trails corrode supports when toggled on.

name: Graviton Maw
description: Gain a magnetic aura that draws coins and chunks from two platforms away.
